## Upload packages and read in data
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(here)
library(stars)
library(tmap)
library(RColorBrewer)

# read in geodatabase of EJScreen data at the Census Block Group level
ejscreen <- sf::st_read(here::here("data", "ejscreen","EJSCREEN_2023_BG_StatePct_with_AS_CNMI_GU_VI.gdb")) 

# filter to a state you are interested in
colorado <- ejscreen %>%
  dplyr::filter(ST_ABBREV == "CO") 

# filter to a county you are interested in
denver <- ejscreen %>%
  dplyr::filter(CNTY_NAME %in% c("Denver County"))

# find the average values for all variables within counties
colorado_counties <- aggregate(colorado, by = list(colorado$CNTY_NAME), FUN = mean)
```

## Map 1: PM 2.5 Levels in Denver County
```{r}
tm_shape(denver) +
    tm_polygons('PM25', palette = "YlOrRd", title = "PM2.5 (µg/m³)") +
      tm_scalebar() +
      tm_compass() +
      tm_layout(
        main.title = "PM 2.5 Air Pollution in Denver County",
        main.title.size= 1.1,
        legend.outside = TRUE
      )
```

## Map 2: Unemployment in Denver County
```{r}
tm_shape(denver) +
    tm_polygons('UNEMPLOYED',
    palette = "Blues",
    style = "cont",
    title = "Unemployment (%)") +
    tm_scalebar() +
    tm_compass() +
    tm_layout(
      main.title = "Unemployment in Denver County",
      main.title.size = 1.1,
      legend.outside = TRUE
    )
```

These maps explore potential environmental justice concerns in Denver County, by comparing particulate matter (PM2.5) concentrations and unemployment rates across census block groups.

Map #1 illustrates the geographic distribution of air pollution, while the second highlights differences in socioeconomic conditions. Together, these maps help examine whether communities experiencing higher unemployment rates may also face greater exposure to air pollution.

Identifying areas where these conditions overlap can raise important questions about environmental injustices and associated environmental health related-risks. It is important to note that these maps alone do not establish a relationship between unemployment and pollution exposure.
